name: Behind the north-wall case run: walk-in cooler / back service band (staff only). The sales-floor boundary runs at y=93 but the first fixture row along the whole north wall starts at y=134-147 (x 393-538 at 142.8, 558-723 at 134.3, 743-942 at 134.7, 991-1114 at 144.5, 1128-1216 at 144.7), leaving a 41 pt (4.8 m) strip with nothing drawn in it, no product word anywhere above y=153, and no badge. Everywhere else on the map the perimeter fixtures hug the boundary (west [386.9,149.7,393.5,319.0], east [1212.0,168.0,1220.2,301.1]); only the north wall has this gap. The cooler doors are drawn as sawtooth swings on the SOUTH face of the y 143-151 run, so shoppers work these cases from the back action alley (y 151-171), not from behind. Same call as 659's 'behind Dairy cases / top wall service band'.

Back-of-house block south of the Pharmacy: Administration offices, the employee break room (six table symbols at x 387-425, y 639-661) and the enclosed restroom vestibule. Every room here is drawn walled with door arcs and none of it is reachable from ENTRANCE in the raw drawing; left open it is a 1300-cell island. North edge is the south face of the Cough & Cold shelf/wall [468.2,634.0,549.4,637.4] and the Pharmacy room's south wall (y=639.5); east edge stops at x=547 so the walkway from aisle 34 down to the front action alley (x 549-570) stays customer floor.

East bump-out back-of-house suite (staff). The boundary polygon steps east at (1222.7,470.2)->(1278.7,470.2)->(1278.7,633.4)->(1222.7,633.4), enclosing 56x163 pt = 114 m2 of floor that has NO fixture, NO product word, NO department label and no directory destination anywhere in it -- the only such space on the map; every other square metre of sales floor carries fixtures or a named open area (Apparel/Floral/Seasonal). Its west face is drawn as a continuous wall -- [1220.2,450.3,1220.2,485.1], [1221.0,495.6,1221.0,503.4], [1223.1,497.4,1223.1,557.3], [1221.6,512.9,1221.6,554.2], [1222.7,569.2,1222.7,580.7], [1219.8,580.7,1219.8,710.7] -- leaving exactly two door-width gaps, y 485.1-495.6 (10.5 pt = 1.22 m) and y 557.3-569.2 (11.9 pt = 1.38 m). Its south third is partitioned into two rooms by [1246.5,581.1,1246.5,634.2] with matching 1.2 m door gaps in the y=581.3 wall at x 1231.7-1242.2 and x 1258.8-1269.3. Walled rooms reached only through single doors, with nothing to sell in them, are back-of-house. The onboarding note left this open on the reading that a '3.1 m gap with no door drawn' opened it to the floor; that measured 470.2->497.4 and missed the [1220.2,450.3,1220.2,485.1] wall segment, so the real opening is one 1.22 m door. Rect starts at x=1222.0 (the drawn wall line) so the 2 pt of floor west of it stays customer side.

Deli service-counter well (staff). The counter is the arc fixture (1050.7,350.5)-(1084.9,386.4); its concave side faces south-west and is closed off by the deli case [1066.2,385.9,1074.1,442.8] at its south tip, leaving a 2.9 m staff entrance between (1051.7,365) and the case corner. Traced from the arc's inner edge.

Seafood service-counter well (staff): interior of the horseshoe counter fixture (1118.2,450.4)-(1146.5,478.2), traced from its inner edge. The C opens north-east with a 2.2 m staff entrance; the customer frontage is the floor south and west of it, restored in inclusions.json.

Cooking Connection demo-kitchen well (staff): interior of the horseshoe counter fixture (1113.9,281.6)-(1149.2,313.3), traced from its inner edge and closed across its east mouth. The 'Cooking Connection' wordmark is printed inside the counter ring, and it is vector artwork with no extracted anchor, so no rule would ever have sealed it.
